description: Create a new system variable. Types: 'bool', 'float' (optional min/max/unit), 'enum' (requires values list), 'string'. Use set_system_variable to write it afterwards, list_system_variables to see existing ones.

confirm.description: Set true to authorize this write against a protected CCU target (e.g. prod). Unlocks writes to that target for the rest of the session.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the WebUI

name.description: New variable name (must not already exist)

values.description: Enum value labels in order (enum only, e.g. ['off','low','high'])

name: create_system_variable
title: Create System Variable
